mainEntity.name: Can One Automation Partner Supply Palletizing, Case Packing and Conveyors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. TRF supplies case packing, conveying and palletizing as one integrated end-of-line solution: TRFRapidpack, TRFOnepack or TRFDroppack pack the cases, TRFIntraflow moves and routes them, and TRFCobot, TRFCompact, TRFSpeed or TRFSubzero build the pallet. With end-of-line integration, one partner is responsible for engineering and integration from layout to startup.

mainEntity.name: How Does Automation Help With Labor Shortages in Food Plants?

acceptedAnswer.text: Automation takes over the repetitive end-of-line tasks that are hardest to staff: grouping and loading products into cases, moving cases by hand and building pallets. Operators move to supervision, quality checks and changeovers, and the line no longer depends on how fast people can lift. Repetitive lifting, bending and twisting also leave the end of the line.

mainEntity.name: How Do I Estimate the Payback of Automation in My Plant?

acceptedAnswer.text: For palletizing, use the palletizing ROI calculator. The estimate divides the system cost, including maintenance, by the annual net savings: the labor cost of manual palletizing minus the electricity the robot uses. The result is an initial planning estimate that a TRF Sales Engineer completes with the costs of your project.
